title: 第25章 头脑风暴第26章 意料之外
content_zh:
“什么办法？”
宋明远抢先问道。
李廷又抢先说道：“简单啊，只要我们确认那晚上，裴将军到底在不在府上就行了。”
姜峰摇头道：“不对，就算那晚裴将军不在府内，也不能由此确定，此事他便全不知情。”
萧凌雪点了点头：“裴将军知不知情，我们很难查。
况且，他当时在不在将军府，本身没有意义。”
不在将军府，不代表事情就不是裴将军做的。
相反，如果在，也有可能是副将瞒着做的，毕竟事情发生在不良人府衙，而不是将军府。
李廷讪讪一笑：“大人说得对。”
姜峰说道：“其实，案情到了这里，我们可以大致推断出来一些事情。
杨儒源确实冒充了张员外，并与刺史府衙，节度使府衙当中的某些人一起密谋走私，至于裴将军是否参与其中，又或者是充当保护伞的角色，目前还无法定论，我们还需要更多的证据。”
李廷反驳道：“我们有张员外提供的书信为证，为何还不能下定论？难道这些信件都是假的？”
姜峰沉吟道：“有定论，不代表能定罪。
裴将军是朝廷的二品将军，光凭张员外的口供，以及这几封书信，恐怕还定不了他的罪，大人，我说的对吧？”
萧凌雪点了点头：“确实如此。”
姜峰说道：“我们要查的是走私案的幕后者，但我们不能直接去查裴将军，因此，案子的突破口还是在张员外这里。”
“针对张员外的供词，目前尚且有几个疑点：半年前，杨儒源为什么要将张员外进行转移？如果是被人发现，我觉得以他的性格，直接杀了张员外反而更加省事。”
“还有就是，杨儒源为什么突然不想走私了？这可以说是整个案子的起因，与走私案也有着巨大的关联，不可忽视。”
他在回应李廷刚刚说的话，旋即将目光转移美女上司身上，沉声道：
“我的猜测是，这期间很可能发生了什么事，让杨儒源感到了危机，所以他想放弃，想退出走私。

这件事，很有可能与半年前他不得不转移张员外有关。”
“想要验证这件事，那就从张员外的身上开始调查。”
“有几个方向可以调查，第一，张员外这半年被囚禁在哪里？又是谁在负责看押？张嚣已死，负责看押的人就是我们的突破口，可以再查一下张嚣的人际关系。”
“第二，半年前杨儒源将张员外转移，也是在半年前，张嚣被驱逐出张府，这个时间发生了什么事，让杨儒源做出这个选择？因此，我们可以调查半年前所有发生过的案件，从卷宗当中看看是否有可疑的人或者事。”
半年前……
忽然，宋明远抬头看向萧凌雪，怔怔道：“大人，卑职记得，您好像就是半年前来的江州城。”
刹那间，满屋寂静！
此时，姜峰目光有些难以置信的看向萧凌雪。
卧槽，难道这位高冷女上司的威名有这么大？刚来江州城，就吓得杨儒源不得不放弃走私？
可转头一想，又觉得此事非常的不合理！
萧凌雪只是一个不良人的副统领，走私团伙当中也有与她相同职位的人，比如郭飞，甚至背后还有裴将军这位二品大佬，他们完全不需要害怕萧凌雪。
萧凌雪沉默不语，面露沉思。
content_en:
"What can I do?"
Song Mingyuan asked first.
Li Ting said first: "It's simple, as long as we confirm whether General Pei is in the house that night."
Jiang Feng shook his head and said: "No, even if General Pei was not in the house that night, we can't confirm it. He didn't know anything about it."
Xiao Lingxue nodded: "Whether General Pei knows or not is difficult for us to find out.
Besides, whether he was in the General's Mansion or not at that time has no meaning in itself. "
Just because he's not in the General's Mansion doesn't mean that General Pei didn't do it.
On the contrary, if he was here, it was possible that the lieutenant-general did it secretly. After all, the incident happened in the bad man's office, not the general's office.
Li Ting smiled coquettishly: "Your Excellency, you are right."
Jiang Feng said: "Actually, now that the case is here, we can roughly infer some things.
Yang Ruyuan indeed impersonated Zhang Yuanwai and conspired with some people from the Governor's Office and the Jiedushi Office to smuggle. As for whether General Pei was involved or acted as a protective umbrella, it is still unclear. We need more evidence. "
Li Ting retorted: "We have the letters provided by Zhang Yuanwai as evidence, why can't we draw a conclusion? Are these letters all fake?"
Jiang Feng muttered: "There is a conclusion, but it does not mean that a conviction can be made.
General Pei is a second-rank general in the imperial court. I'm afraid I can't convict him just based on Zhang Yuanwai's confession and these letters. My lord, am I right? "
Xiao Lingxue nodded: "That's true."
Jiang Feng said: "What we want to investigate is the person behind the smuggling case, but we cannot directly investigate General Pei. Therefore, the breakthrough in the case is still here at Zhang Yuanwai."
"There are currently several doubts about Zhang Yuanwai's confession: Why did Yang Ruyuan transfer Zhang Yuanwai six months ago? If he was discovered, I think it would be easier to kill Zhang Yuanwai directly based on his character."
"Also, why did Yang Ruyuan suddenly not want to smuggle? This can be said to be the cause of the entire case. It is also closely related to the smuggling case and cannot be ignored."
In response to what Li Ting just said, he immediately turned his attention to his beautiful boss and said in a deep voice:
"My guess is that something probably happened during this period that made Yang Ruyuan feel in danger, so he wanted to give up and quit smuggling.
This incident is most likely related to the fact that he had to transfer Zhang Yuanwai six months ago. "
"If you want to verify this, let's start the investigation from Zhang Yuanwai."
"There are several directions we can investigate. First, where has Zhang Yuanwai been imprisoned for the past six months? And who is responsible for his custody? Zhang Xiao is dead. The person responsible for his custody is our breakthrough point. We can check Zhang Xiao's interpersonal relationships again."
"Second, Yang Ruyuan transferred Yuan Zhang to a foreign country half a year ago. It was also half a year ago that Zhang Xiao was expelled from the Zhang Mansion. What happened at this time to make Yang Ruyuan make this choice? Therefore, we can investigate all the cases that happened half a year ago and see if there are any suspicious people or things in the files."
Half a year ago...
Suddenly, Song Mingyuan raised his head and looked at Xiao Lingxue, and said in a daze: "Sir, please remember that you are the one who came to Jiangzhou City half a year ago."
In an instant, the whole house was silent!
At this time, Jiang Feng looked at Xiao Lingxue in disbelief.
Damn it, is this cold female boss so famous? When he first arrived in Jiangzhou City, Yang Ruyuan was so scared that he had to give up smuggling?
But when I think about it again, I feel that this matter is very unreasonable!
Xiao Lingxue is just the deputy leader of a bad guy. There are people in the same position as her in the smuggling gang, such as Guo Fei, and even General Pei, a second-level boss behind him. They don't need to be afraid of Xiao Lingxue at all.
Xiao Lingxue remained silent, looking thoughtful.
